pages.title: The goal
pages.body:
Race all four of your pawns from your [b]homebase[/b] (the crossed square on your side) to [b]home[/b], the crossed square in the middle.

The first player to bring all four pawns home wins.

pages.title: Throwing the cowries
pages.body:
Hold on the board (or your shells), shake, then flick and let go.

Count the shells that land [b]open side up[/b]: 1, 2 or 3 move that many squares. All four up is [b]Chamma[/b] (4); none up is [b]Ashta[/b] (8).

A 4 or an 8 means [b]throw again[/b]. Your throws add up, and you spend them in any order, on any pawns. But throw 4 or 8 three times in a row and you lose them all.

pages.title: Moving
pages.body:
Pawns go round the [b]outer ring[/b] anticlockwise from your homebase, then turn into the [b]inner ring[/b] and spiral to home.

To land on home you need the exact throw. A throw no pawn can use is lost.

pages.title: Safe squares
pages.body:
The nine [b]crossed squares[/b] are safe: nobody can be captured there, and any number of pawns may share one.

On every other square only one pawn fits: you can't stack your own pawns there.

pages.title: Capturing, and the gate
pages.body:
Land on an opponent's pawn on a plain square to [b]capture[/b] it: it goes back to its homebase, and you get an extra throw.

The [b]inner ring is shut[/b] until you've captured someone. Until then your pawns keep circling the outer ring. Your first capture opens the gate.

pages.title: Cards (if the host turns them on)
pages.body:
Each player starts with five Ganjifa cards: the host chooses a [b]private pick[/b] (keep 5 of your own 10) or an [b]open draft[/b] (take turns picking from one face-up pool, everyone watching).

Play at most one card a turn, before you throw. Each card can be used once. Hover or tap a card to read it.

pages.title: Controls
pages.body:
[b]Mouse:[/b] point at a pawn to see its move, click to move it. Click a throw to use it next.
[b]Touch:[/b] tap to see, tap again to do it.
[b]Keyboard / gamepad:[/b] Space / A to hold and throw, arrows / stick to shake; Left / Right to choose, Enter / A to pick; Up / Down to switch throws; C / Y for your cards; Tab / Back for the log; Esc / B to cancel.
